requestingAuthority.intent: Extend the existing fixed ground comparator for diagnostic-only shader isolation on immutable product9127904e725a3f4ca13c1221451023102ad09435. Capture three existing fixed poses (foothill-west, inland-seam-near, coastal-seam-east) with four closed modes: original grass-hidden reference, unlit final ground albedo, uniform gray with original lighting, and RGB actual sand/habitat/bank-contact coverage weights. Only in-memory intercepted renderer responses may differ; product checkout, geometry, camera, assets and live site remain unchanged. Preserve frame, asset, exact-head and failure guards; record source/transformed hashes and explicit diagnostic mode metadata. Reuse H_EARTH_NEUTRAL_EXACT_HEAD_RUN and its fixed query, no new capability or arbitrary shader input. Exactly12 captures on one product head; CPU triangle/source diagnosis may precede captures. Tooling-only merge after tests and independent review; no visual acceptance from diagnostic renders.
requestingAuthority.source: Owner: Proceed accordingly after proposed three diagnostic view types and developer-source research, following negative Gen2914 visual result.
